comments:
The same manuscript appears twice in [ZZVAXS4X].
In vol. 80, only the text up to fol. 100 (and the images of fol. 19ab and of fol. 64a are missing).
In vol. 42, the whole text is reproduced (with a lineage after the colophon). An additional folio (number unclear), which appears to belong to another text, is found between fol. 214 and fol. 215. The last folio is numbered 273, but there are irregularities in the folio numbering.
